Find the ratio of the number of delivery partners who joined Clipkart (in 2019 and 2020) to the number of delivery partners who joined Tomato (in 2019 and 2020).
solution:
**Given:**

The number of delivery partner joined Clipkart in 2019 & 2020 respectively = 5.6 and 6.4 thousand

The number of delivery partners joined Tomato in 2019 and 2020 respectively = 2.7 and 3.3 thousand

**Calculation:**

According to the question

The sum of the joined partners of the Clipkart = 5.6 + 6.4 = 12 thousand

The sum of the joined partners of the Tomato = 2.7 + 3.3 = 6 thousand

The required ratio = 12 : 6 = 2 : 1

**∴ The required result will be 2 : 1. **
